messages:
Iana: hey team! i’m Iana — joined today on infra. excited to be here :tada:
Iana: fun fact: my desk plant (a tiny fern) is already stealing office sunlight. desk is D4 near the big window. anyone know the best fern-care hack?
Mira: welcome Iana!! :wave: we have a plant-sitting rota but it’s low-key — usually just water every 4-5 days. also there’s a tiny watering can under the kitchen sink.
Sam: hi Iana — if your fern starts calling the elevator, it’s normal. bring extra plant snacks (bananas are a myth) :seedling:
Noah: welcome!! if you want, i can swing by today and show you the best coffee machine settings. also we have a spare plant clamp for window-sitters.
Olivia: welcome welcome. stolen-sunlight cred already earned. also FYI rooftop meetup at 4pm — come say hi.
Iana: omg rooftop!! i’ll be there. thanks for the fern tips.
HR-bot: Hi Iana :wave: Your badge should be at reception. If you need IT setup, ping #eng-devex or DM Sam. Reminder: first-week intro lunch is tomorrow at 12:30.
Sam: cc @Iana — i’ll DM you about getting you on the coffee subscription and show the espresso settings.
Mira: pro tip: keep the fern out of direct blast from the AC. it throws tantrums.
Kai: welcome! we have a very competitive mug culture — bring your favorite. also we stole a tiny succulent from marketing once, it’s now on the 3rd floor.
Iana: haha love the mug culture. my mug is a tiny fox so it should fit right in. thanks for the warm welcome everyone :heart:
Noah: quick poll — who will be on rooftop at 4? 
Mira: me
Sam: me
Olivia: me
Iana: me!!
Kai: maybe
HR-bot: Note: if you’re attending the rooftop event, please RSVP in the #all-hands channel so we can order snacks.
Iana: will do. last q: is there an unofficial fern name suggestion box?
Mira: call it "Photosynthesis Steve" unless it prefers something more poetic.
Sam: "Stevie Leaf" is my vote.
Olivia: "Fernie Sanders" if it’s politically active. :laughing:
Iana: stevie leaf is perfect. planting the name now. thanks again — see you all at 4pm :sun_with_face:
Noah: welcome aboard, Iana! :rocket:
HR-bot: New hire checklist updated: badge collected ✅, intro lunch RSVP pending.
